name: BlitzGreymon
look: a towering red war-machine: crimson armour with grey joints, two huge shoulder cannon pods, Gatling forearms, a crested red helmet with a yellow visor, three-clawed grey feet and a glowing thruster pack
entry: A war-machine Digimon armoured in crimson. Its shoulder cannons and Gatling arms fire without pause until nothing in front of it is left standing.
how: Evolves into Omegamon Alter-S at level 55, learning Grey Sword.
